{{recipe}} | [[Cookbook:Vegetarian cuisine|Vegetarian Cuisine]] | [[Cookbook:Holiday Recipes|Holiday Recipes]]

== Ingredients ==
* 6 [[Cookbook:Cinnamon|cinnamon]] sticks
* 1 small whole [[Cookbook:Nutmeg|nutmeg]]
* ½ [[Cookbook:Cup|cup]] ({{convert|60|g|oz|abbr=on|disp=s}}) whole [[Cookbook:Clove|cloves]]
* ½ cup ({{convert|60|g|oz|abbr=on|disp=s}}) whole [[Cookbook:Allspice|allspice]]
* Grated peel of 1 whole [[Cookbook:Orange|orange]]

== Procedure ==
# Place whole cinnamon sticks and nutmeg in a large ziplock bag.
# Use a hammer to crush the spices into rough chips.
# Combine the chips with cloves and allspice.
# Store in an airtight container.

== Use ==
To make spiced wine or cider:
#  Add 2 [[Cookbook:Tablespoon|tablespoons]] of the spice mixture to 4 [[Cookbook:Cup|cups]] ({{convert|1|L|USqt|abbr=on|disp=s}}) of [[Cookbook:Wine|wine]] or cider.
# Add peel of 1 fresh orange.
# [[Cookbook:Simmering|Simmer]] slowly over medium heat for 5–10 minutes.
# [[Cookbook:Straining|Strain]] liquid; serve hot wine or cider in mugs.
